name: Inabtanin
isnote: Unresolved near the base of Azhdarchomorpha (Rosenbach et al. 2024); not formally assigned to a family.
sum: Large toothless azhdarchoid from the latest Maastrichtian of Jordan — one of the most complete pterosaurs from Afro-Arabia.
wsnote: Estimated 5.35 m (adult) — the only non-azhdarchid azhdarchoid above 5 m.
material: Much of the jaws, four partial neck vertebrae, left scapulocoracoid and humerus, much of the right forelimb.
biology: Lived alongside the giant azhdarchid Arambourgiania on the southern Tethys coast; diet unknown.
author: Rosenbach et al. 2024
